programme.desc: A woman suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick ensnares a San Francisco cop in a web of lust and deceit.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Bridge
programme.desc: A rich Midwestern lawyer (Paul Newman), his wife (Joanne Woodward) and their children grow apart in the World War II era.

programme.title: Rio Grande
programme.desc: A cavalry colonel's (John Wayne) Southern wife (Maureen O'Hara) and estranged son, a soldier, join him at a fort out West.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: Desperate townspeople hire seven mercenaries (Denzel Washington, Chris Pratt, Ethan Hawke) to battle a greedy industrialist (Peter Sarsgaard) and his ruthless henchmen in the Old West.

programme.title: Project Almanac
programme.desc: A high-school science nerd (Jonny Weston) and his friends build a time machine, but their joy is short-lived when they discover the ripple effects of its use.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Separation anxiety poses a problem for two co-dependent high school seniors who hope to score booze and babes at a party.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: A supermodel (Ben Stiller) befriends a rival (Owen Wilson) while becoming mixed-up in a brainwashing and assassination plot.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: A special agent recruits former models Derek Zoolander and Hansel to save the world's most beautiful people from a deadly plot.

programme.title: Spectre
programme.desc: As James Bond (Daniel Craig) ventures toward the heart of the sinister organization SPECTRE, he discovers a chilling connection between himself and the enemy (Christoph Waltz) he seeks.

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) goes on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers.

programme.title: In the Land of Saints and Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to leave his dark past behind him, former assassin Finbar Murphy leads a quiet life in a coastal Irish town. However, when terrorists show up, he must soon choose between exposing his secret identity and defending his friends and neighbors.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team must track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity if it falls into the wrong hands. With control of the future and the fate of the world at stake, a deadly race around the globe begins.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: Jack Ryan (Ben Affleck) and the CIA director (Morgan Freeman) try to stop terrorists who are planning a nuclear attack.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: A group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett.

programme.title: Hour of the Gun
programme.desc: Wyatt Earp (James Garner) deputizes Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) and forms a posse to hunt Ike Clanton (Robert Ryan) and his gang.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: Determined to be an important figure in affairs of state, the Duchess of Devonshire (Keira Knightley) rises to the forefront of the Whig Party in the late 1700s and ushers in reforms.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: A lieutenant colonel and approximately 400 U.S. troops battle 2,000 North Vietnamese soldiers in 1965.

programme.title: The Fire Inside
programme.desc: The story of Claressa "T-Rex" Shields, a boxer from Flint, Mich., who trained to become the first woman in her country's history to win an Olympic gold medal in the sport.

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Long-retired boxer Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) agrees to train Apollo Creed's son (Michael B. Jordan) to become a fighter, even as the former champ battles an opponent deadlier than any he ever faced in the ring.

programme.title: Challengers
programme.desc: Tensions run high when a grand slam tennis champion finds himself standing across the net from the once-promising, now burnt-out Patrick, his former best friend and his wife's former boyfriend.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: As mankind's time on Earth comes to an end, a group of explorers (Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway) begins the most important mission in human history: traveling beyond the galaxy to discover if there is a future for man among the stars.

programme.title: Love's Enduring Promise
programme.desc: In this Janette Oke sequel to "Love Comes Softly," the eldest child in an 1800s frontier family, Missie Davis is a bright and beautiful elementary schoolteacher whose love for the prairie is matched only by her passion for books. When Missie encounters Grant, a handsome New England railroad executive, she feels as though shes met a hero from one of her novels.

programme.title: Where There's a Will
programme.desc: A debt-ridden con man returns home to care for his wealthy grandmother hoping to become her sole heir.

programme.title: Rescuing Madison
programme.desc: After a fireman saves the life of a pop-music star, a romance is sparked, but her former boyfriend is finding it hard to let go.

programme.title: Mom and Dad Undergrads
programme.desc: Parents enroll in college to be closer to their kids, though they have vastly different reasons for doing so.

programme.title: Hearts on Fire
programme.desc: Romance blooms between a single mom and an injured firefighter who is renting a room in her home while he recovers. Though her kids are instantly taken with him, the woman has doubts about the wisdom of starting a new relationship.

programme.title: Love Finds a Home
programme.desc: Dr. Belinda Owens (Sarah Jones) cares for her pregnant friend, whose opinionated mother-in-law (Patty Duke) resists Belinda's scientific approach to medicine. Adding to Belinda's worries is her own desire, but seeming inability, to become pregnant. Haylie Duff and Jordan Bridges also star. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.title: Tomboy
programme.desc: Tori has always been one of the guys, but since her recent attempt to become more lady-like, she finds herself torn between a man who's fallen for her new femininity and a friend who loves her for the tomboy she's always been.

programme.title: A Kiss at Midnight
programme.desc: A woman (Faith Ford) who runs a dating service registers with a rival Internet matchmaker to prove her business is better, but ends up being successfully matched with the site's owner (Cameron Daddo). Dyan Cannon and Hal Linden also star.

programme.title: Same Time Next Week
programme.desc: When Christy meets Charlie, they discover that they have a lot in common than their lost spouses.

programme.title: When Duty Calls
programme.desc: Newlyweds Ellie and Martin move in with her parents while she waits for a job on the local police force. Their relationship is strained when Ellie, who had been working to solve a string of robberies, learns that Martin has been offered a job in Maine.

programme.title: Change of Heart
programme.desc: A TV producer decides to set a show at a bed and breakfast and bonds with the owner's son. But he becomes furious after learning one of her secrets.

programme.title: Once Upon a Date
programme.desc: A real-estate broker tasked with buying a community playhouse falls for the owner's daughter.

programme.title: Always a Bride
programme.desc: A woman lets loose during her bachelorette party in Las Vegas and wakes up married to a movie star, much to her fiancé's chagrin. Delays with an annulment further complicate matters, and the woman is left questioning which man is truly right for her.

programme.title: Straight From the Heart
programme.desc: A singles ad leads to an unlikely courtship between a Big Apple photographer (Teri Polo) and a widowed Wyoming rancher (Andrew McCarthy). Patricia Kalember, Greg Evigan. Carla: Christine Tucci. Howard: J. Kenneth Campbell. Jesse: David Jean-Thomas.

programme.title: Mystery Girl
programme.desc: A man (Sean Patrick Flanery) sends secret-admirer e-mails to his crush (Christine Scott Bennett), but an e-mail-address mix-up causes the notes to go to the woman's lovelorn coworker (Brigid Brannagh) instead. And though the man and his crush start dating, he can't help but feel a connection with the woman he'd been e-mailing. Directed by Allison Anders.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Love
programme.desc: A meteorology graduate student gets the opportunity to do the weather on a local TV-news show, where there's the potential for a full-time job and a possible romance with a co-worker.

programme.title: A Soldier's Love Story
programme.desc: A divorcée (Lori Loughlin) falls for a soldier (Johnny Messner) who has become a mentor to her son while home on leave. Despite their mutual attraction, the pair are hesitant to start a romance in light of the soldier's upcoming deployment overseas. Harvey Frost directed.

programme.title: Grand Champion
programme.desc: Stock heart-warmer about a preteen cowboy (Jacob Fisher) and his prize steer on a quest to win a prestigious cattle show in Texas. Joey Lauren Adams, Cache Williams. Written and directed by Barry Tubb, the film features cameos by Bruce Willis and Julia Roberts (whose husband, Daniel Moder, handles the cinematography), and country stars George Strait, Robert Earl Keen and Natalie Maines, of the Dixie Chicks.

programme.title: Friend Request
programme.desc: A woman seeking romance finds an ideal man online, but she gets a surprise when she meets him and learns that his young son was posing as his dad and communicating with her.

programme.title: Mulligan
programme.desc: A kids-show actor (Ethan Erickson) and a single mom (Jennie Garth) butt heads after the two are in a car accident. But while dealing with the fallout from the crash, the pair begin to make a real connection. The actor's secrets, however, threaten to ruin the fledgling romance. David Burton Morris directed.

programme.title: Decoration Day
programme.desc: James Garner stars as a retired judge whose cantankerous attitude is tempered by a troubled godchild (Norm Skaggs), a black tenant farmer (Bill Cobbs) who refuses the Medal of Honor and a blossoming romance. Judith Ivey. Rowena: Ruby Dee. Michael Waring: Larry Fishburne. Loreen: Jo Anderson. Judge Wesley: Wallace Wilkinson. Adapted from the novella by John William Corrington.

programme.title: The Wedding Do Over
programme.desc: Wedding planner Abby specializes in fixing weddings that went wrong, but when she is forced to work with her ex-fiancé, she begins to question whether their relationship was the disaster she remembers.

programme.title: Elevator Girl
programme.desc: An uptight lawyer (Ryan Merriman) and a free-spirited woman (Lacey Chabert) become trapped in an elevator together. The incident produces sparks between the two, but their different lifestyles threaten to ruin the romance before it gets off the ground. Patty McCormack, Hedy Burress and Jonathan Bennett also star. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Love
programme.desc: A meteorology graduate student gets the opportunity to do the weather on a local TV-news show, where there's the potential for a full-time job and a possible romance with a co-worker.

programme.title: A Soldier's Love Story
programme.desc: A divorcée (Lori Loughlin) falls for a soldier (Johnny Messner) who has become a mentor to her son while home on leave. Despite their mutual attraction, the pair are hesitant to start a romance in light of the soldier's upcoming deployment overseas. Harvey Frost directed.

programme.title: Grand Champion
programme.desc: Stock heart-warmer about a preteen cowboy (Jacob Fisher) and his prize steer on a quest to win a prestigious cattle show in Texas. Joey Lauren Adams, Cache Williams. Written and directed by Barry Tubb, the film features cameos by Bruce Willis and Julia Roberts (whose husband, Daniel Moder, handles the cinematography), and country stars George Strait, Robert Earl Keen and Natalie Maines, of the Dixie Chicks.

programme.title: Falling in Love with the Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Mark Lucas and Theresa Connolly fall in love but their overbearing mothers ruin their wedding plans and possibly their future together.

programme.title: By Dawn's Early Light
programme.desc: A spoiled L.A. teen spends the summer in rural Colorado with his grandfather who decides to teach the boy a lesson by taking him on an 800-mile horseback ride.

programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Missie's surprise pregnancy sets her on a new course that is both thrilling and terrifying. After all the planning and dreaming, she and her husband, Willie, have headed west in a covered wagon, leaving behind the prairie home of Missie's parents. Now, caught between the excitement of the new adventure and the pain of not knowing when she'll see her family again, Missie copes with the challenges, and cherishes the rewards, of her new homestead.

programme.title: Our House
programme.desc: March 25, 2006 Ruth Galloway is a well-to-do socialite who's not quite as secure inside as she seems from the outside. When a young woman named Billy saves her life, Ruth decides to turn her mansion into a shelter for the city's homeless.

programme.title: Touched
programme.desc: A young nurse who takes a job as a live-in caretaker for a cantankerous, dying novelist discovers the secret of why the elderly woman is estranged from her son, and sets out to do something about it.

programme.title: The Joneses Unplugged
programme.desc: Newlyweds who are struggling with their relationship reconnect during a blackout, when their electronic devices are not working.

programme.title: Generation Gap
programme.desc: A rebellious teen (Alex Black) reluctantly spends the summer with his strict war-veteran grandfather (Ed Asner). While the two clash at first, they soon bring about positive changes in each other that lead to new friendships and experiences. Rue McClanahan, Catherine Mary Stewart, Ralph Waite. Directed by Bill L. Norton.

programme.title: Love's Enduring Promise
programme.desc: In this Janette Oke sequel to "Love Comes Softly," the eldest child in an 1800s frontier family, Missie Davis is a bright and beautiful elementary schoolteacher whose love for the prairie is matched only by her passion for books. When Missie encounters Grant, a handsome New England railroad executive, she feels as though shes met a hero from one of her novels.

programme.title: Rescuing Madison
programme.desc: After a fireman saves the life of a pop-music star, a romance is sparked, but her former boyfriend is finding it hard to let go.

programme.title: Change of Heart
programme.desc: A TV producer decides to set a show at a bed and breakfast and bonds with the owner's son. But he becomes furious after learning one of her secrets.

programme.title: Tomboy
programme.desc: Tori has always been one of the guys, but since her recent attempt to become more lady-like, she finds herself torn between a man who's fallen for her new femininity and a friend who loves her for the tomboy she's always been.

programme.title: Where There's a Will
programme.desc: A debt-ridden con man returns home to care for his wealthy grandmother hoping to become her sole heir.

programme.title: Always and Forever
programme.desc: Former high-school sweethearts Grace and Michael (Rena Sofer and Dean McDermott) reconnect at their 20-year high-school reunion. Sparks fly, but the pair are hesitant to jump into a relationship that already failed once. Grace's mom (Barbara Eden), meanwhile, is quick to offer her two cents on her daughter's romantic woes. Max Gail and Rob Boltin also star. Directed by Kevin Connor.

programme.title: A Kiss at Midnight
programme.desc: A woman (Faith Ford) who runs a dating service registers with a rival Internet matchmaker to prove her business is better, but ends up being successfully matched with the site's owner (Cameron Daddo). Dyan Cannon and Hal Linden also star.

programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: Marty is a 19 year old pioneer woman, recently married. She goes west with her husband Clem, hoping to start a new life. But Clem unexpectedly dies, and Marty finds herself alone, two months pregnant. Clark Davis, a widower, offers her a marriage of convenience: she needs food and money, and he needs someone to take care of his daughter Missie. She accepts his proposal as a temporary solution.

programme.title: The Flower Girl
programme.desc: A young florist and wedding planner suddenly goes from being single and unlucky at love, to dating two fantastic men, and is forced to make a life-altering decision about her fundamental values about love and family.

programme.desc: Period action romance starring Chow Yun-Fat, Michelle Yeoh and Zhang Ziyi. China in the 19th century: having failed to avenge the murder of his master by the evil Jade Fox, martial arts expert Li Mu Bai renounces fighting for a life of meditation. But when his antique sword, Green Destiny, is stolen by Jen, a young aristocrat, Li and his fellow warrior Yu Shu Lien give chase.

programme.desc: Action adventure starring Brendan Fraser. While on an expedition to search for his missing brother, a geologist and his companions become trapped in a cave. programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island

programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. Shrek is a grumpy green ogre whose swamp is overrun with homeless traditional fairy-tale characters. To get them evicted by evil Lord Farquaad, he must rescue Princess Fiona from her dragon-guarded tower, with only a talking donkey for company.

A lonely boy taking refuge from bullies in an old shop discovers a mysterious book depicting the land of Fantasia. The ancient country is under threat from an evil force and the boy finds himself drawn into the story.

programme.desc: Epic sci-fi drama starring Timothée Chalamet and Zendaya. With the evil Harkonnen family back in charge of Arrakis, deposed heir Paul Atreides and his mother have taken refuge with the native Fremen in the planet's perilous desert wasteland. Paul becomes close with Fremen warrior Chani and begins to demonstrate powers that persuade her people to aid in the young man's plan to avenge his father and take back control.
